South Carolina’s Constitutional Convention of 1868 is one of the most progressive in the history of our state. It established the public school system, affirmed that all 21+ year old males could vote regardless of if they owned property, and made divorce legal. It also nullified Black Codes.

title: Rent control for land leases.
body:
South Carolina has quite a few 55+ mobile home communities. They were once an affordable option for the elderly on fixed incomes or the disabled. Since investment firms have come in and bought up many of these communities the land leases have skyrocketed. Land leases mean you own your home but lease the land it sits on, there are no current laws to cap how high they can go. Tenants are held hostage because they cannot afford to move their homes, nor can they sell them with such high leases attached. 

I live in such a community and we need HELP.

Our politicians lap up contributions from big tech, giving them tax incentives and then try to shove another data center in our back yards.

Property tax should not be assessed on anything except for real estate & only at the time of sale and paid by the new buyer at the current value.

title: Infrastructure Affects Everything
body: I want us to tackle infrastructure. It matters to me because it affects daily life opportunity and the future of our communities.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Plan Roads for 2050
body: We need to improve infrastructure by 2050.  The state should start now by adding main roads, feeder roads and widening existing roads. Traffic is horrible. I live in the country and traffic has found us. It affects all of our travel plans, even just going to the grocery store. To stay out of the worst of traffic, we try and drive between 9am and 3pm.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Hour to Cross Town
body: I want us to tackle infrastructure. It matters to me because it often takes an hour to get across town due to traffic.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Need Passenger Rail
body: We need to do something about our state's infrastructure. The rest of the country and world are investing in public transit like high speed rail and we're adding a badly planned bus to Charleston that is only going to make traffic worse--why? We do not currently have a passenger rail, when we had it for a hundred years until the late 1960s. If I could get on a train that took me to Charleston, I would. If I could get on a train that took me to Columbia, I would. It matters to me because traffic is horrific and only getting worse.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Roads and Lost Productivity
body: I want us to tackle infrastructure because it isn't keeping up with population growth. It matters to me because it impacts every day life when you cannot access the services that you need.  I am very frustrated becaus I pay taxes but feel like I am not benefiting.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Infrastructure Can't Handle Growth
body: My top priority is infrastructure because the state isn't handling the population growth.  My grandchild is unable to attend the school closest to his house because there isn't room for him.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Generation Priced Out
body: South Carolina should focus on access to housing. With housing costs rising astronomically it is genuinely pricing an entire generation out of being able to start families, contribute to building their communities, and building wealth in the form of equity.  The middle class is disappearing. Housing is not supposed to be an inflationary asset and this is not the sign of a sustainable economy or asset. A large portion of South Carolinians live below the poverty line. Without a program to help restore housing in South Carolina, many native residents will be priced out of their birth state. The system does not work for us and we are desperately hoping for help.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Senior Struggles with Costs
body: My top priority is housing prices, which are crazy expensive here; even rentals are out of control. Salaries and hourly rates are so low. It's extremely difficult to own a home or find a rental that's not in the projects in North Charleston. Property and car insurance are so over priced. Even with the primary rate of 4%, it takes its toll. Taxes are too high. It matters to me because as a retired senior, it's very difficult to make ends meet month to month.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Need Roommates at 56
body: We should solve affordable housing. I'm considering getting roommates at 56 years old (not cool) just to survive.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Food and Housing Insecurity
body: We should solve food and housing insecurity. We live paycheck to paycheck, I have an adult child and a minor child that are disabled and they require more than most. I work at the hospital and my husband works in job recruitment. Not only are we feeling the impact, we are seeing it first hand. People can not get good jobs because jobs want 20 years of experience on relatively no income. People are so overwhelmed with taxes and medical bills and unable to get help that our low income programs are being utilized by so many people. After healthcare and taxes, I'm hardly bringing any income home.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Climate and Insurance Impact Housing
body: We should solve housing costs. It is one of the biggest challenges facing SC, however it is a result of multiple issues and not just the costs of building. Insurance rates continue to rise due to disasters related to changing climate. Energy costs are increasing and low wages, especially for minimum wage earners, make housing a major challenge. As a property owner, it affects me personally in increased costs to own a home. As a property manager, tenants struggle monthly with rising costs of utilities and rent payments.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Church Members Unhoused
body: I want us to tackle housing because many of my church members are unhoused.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Workforce Housing Crisis
body: My top priority is workforce housing because it is too expensive where tourism is popular. It means people have to travel long distances to get to their jobs in resorts, hotels, restaurants, bars, etc. We need affordable housing closer to where people work. If we can't have that, then we at least need better public transportation options. I see how it affects people in the coastal communities where workers live, supporting the more effluent areas.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Women's Choice Rights
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be banning abortions. It matters to me because not every woman should be able to make a choice.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Life-Saving Abortions Banned
body: I want us to tackle women's medical rights.  I've had to have three emergency medical abortions in the second trimester, all to save my life in wanted pregnancies. I would be dead if that happened now, so we can't try anymore if we live here.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Reproductive Healthcare Access
body: We should solve women's reproductive rights. I work in women's health and have friends who've needed services & medical care that is banned.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Premiums Jumped Dramatically
body: The one problem I'd solve is getting healthcare and preventative care to the population. My health plan costs are going up from $18.00/month to $200.00/month. There are many families here in SC that will not be able to afford this type of increase.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Insurance Costs Too High
body: I want to solve healthcare. The cost of my health insurance premiums will be 30% of my income.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Medicaid Expansion Needed
body: The one problem I'd solve is expanding Medicaid. It affects my household. My stepdaughter and grandson participate in it.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Wait Times and Misdiagnosis
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be healthcare reform. It matters to me because it's ridiculous that you have to wait for specialists appointments and then be misdiagnosed.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Rural Healthcare Access
body: My top priority is rural healthcare and lack of providers. I've been involved in the industry for 25 years and this keeps coming up as a major issue. People do not get the care that they need in rural areas.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Women's Healthcare Rights
body: I want us to improve women's rights for healthcare and equal pay.  Yes, because I'm a woman. All women deserve it.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Can't Afford Healthcare
body: We should solve healthcare. It matters to me because I can't pay the insurance fees on a fixed income.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: More Freedoms
body: I think the state government isn't the problem. I think the people need more education to understand the issues. We need more freedoms.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Need More Elections
body: I think there should be more elections. We need more turnover of our representatives including getting younger people into office.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Taxation Without Representation
body: South Carolina government needs to represent all the people not just a handful of like-minded donors. I live here. I am tired of taxation with no representation.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: 40% Have No Voice
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be 40% of the people have no voice. I am not heard or seen by lawmakers.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Single Party Rule Problem
body: I want us to change single party rule at the statehouse that supported partisan gerrymandering. My statehouse representative used to be a middle of the road representative whom I trusted to prioritize the needs of his constituency. Now I have a representative who receives a lot of outside funding and pushes policies that I don't support. This sounds like a political rant but it really is a desire for excellence rather than an acceptance of mediocrity through the lack of competing ideas and need to build consensus.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Political Ignorance is Depressing
body: I want us to fix partisan politics. It matters to me because there is an incredible ignorance of truth in politics and it is depressing and not getting us anywhere.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Gerrymandering Limits Representation
body: I want us to stop gerrymandering. It matters to me because makes it harder to elect people that align with my priorities. I don't feel represented.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Toxic Chemical Exposure
body: I want us to tackle toxic and hormone-disrupting chemicals and heavy metals, both old and newly applied, throughout our environment. Helicopters and road crews are spraying herbicides that are known toxins. As a biologist working on spills and a cancer survivor, I see this is a big risk to our state. The cancer rates and other health impacts in this state are very high.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Farmland Being Developed
body: I want us to tackle rapid, uncontrolled development. It matters to me because developers buying up all the farmlands around us.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Solar Farms Forced on Citizens
body: I want us to tackle mega solar farms that are being forced on local citizens who are not aware that is happening until it is too late. It has happened in my area.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Coastal Overgrowth
body: We should solve overgrowth on the coast because it is significant in our way of life and something that we are losing over time. It matters to me because it affects everyone with less beach access, costly beach access, and rising insurance costs due to flooding and other natural disasters.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Energy Costs Impact All
body: The one problem I'd solve is greater energy sufficiency. It matters to me because energy costs impact us all.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Climate Change Impact
body: South Carolina should focus on climate change. My family owns land on the sea islands in the Low Country. We are being pounded by intense storms, sea level rise, salt water intrusion etc.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Energy and Water Limits
body: We should solve in my area it is population growth. Our water and energy sources are being pushed to the limit. We now have peak hours of use where our energy rates increase drastically. Right now the blackout hours are 6am-9am.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Overbuilding Damages Environment
body: My top priority is over building. It matters to me because it wrecks the environment and displaces animals. There are too many stresses on the land.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Environmental Destruction
body: I want us to tackle protecting our environment. Just watch 1700 acres destroyed for an industry three blocks away from my house.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Farmer Water Concerns
body: The one problem I'd solve is water use management. I am a new regenerative grazing farmer. High quality water is a keystone of our survival.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Growth Without Planning
body: The one challenge I'd solve is unfettered growth without attention to infrastructure planning. Commute times, car accidents, and crime are increasing. I have been a victim of all.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Rapid Growth Strain
body: One of the biggest challenges South Carolina is facing right now is how fast the state is growing and how hard it is for our infrastructure, housing, and services to keep up. Roads are crowded, housing costs are rising, and many communities still struggle with access to good healthcare and education. People love living here, but the rapid growth is exposing gaps that really need attention so the state can stay healthy, safe, and sustainable for everyone. Yes, this affects me personally because the gaps show up every day. I experienced firsthand how the low pay and constant strain of the education system lead to burnout, which ultimately pushed me to step away from a field I cared deeply about.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Water Quality Crisis
body: One of the biggest challenges in South Carolina right now is the quality of water. I believe it is more than just old infrastructure. The water plant operations should be tested to figure out how to improve the actual water for residents. This situation affects me personally, as well as many other residents in Florence county. We constantly have to boil water. We spend lots of money on bottled water to cook and drink.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Preserve SC Identity
body: South Carolina has a lot people moving into our state. How do we keep this from changing the identity of our state? I love SC and I don't want it to change to be like other states. I want newcomers to be a part of us, not come change things.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Ignoring Black History
body: South Carolina should focus on the fact that it still continues to whitewash and erase history of the African and African Americans who built this state. It affects everyone as we all remain uneducated and miseducated.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Women in Leadership
body: We need more women in leadership roles across the state. In elected office, in business, and everywhere else. Women are not fairly represented in decision-making and they are over 50% of the population.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Mutual Respect in Legislature
body: My top priority is mutual respect among legislators. It is ok to disagree, but be respectful.  Have lunch together after a difficult but respectful debate. It matters to me because it impacts the whole population and how we see our identity in South Carolina. They are the leaders of our state and should set a better example for the wider society.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Elderly and Disabled Care
body: My top priority is decent care for the elderly and disabled. I am 60 years old and with 2 strokes unable to walk or talk. My husband is 46 blind and on dialysis and is recovering from triple bypass surgery.  It is very hard for us.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Book Bans in Schools
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be the erosions of our freedoms. Books are banned from the libraries in my kids' school district.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: LGBT Discrimination
body: If we could fix one problem, it would be partisan politics. The partisan politics has been discriminating and scapegoating against LGBT people for years and I'm LGBT.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Rights Being Taken Away
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be partisan politics. It matters to me because they are taking away our rights.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Lost Ability to Unite
body: We have seem to lost the ability to unite towards a collective future that represents the broad spectrum of ideas and objectives. Being divisive only hurts us. It keeps our eyes on our own feet. It matters to me because discourse has declined and we are lacking meaningful conversation that allows for forward movement.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Race Relations and Equality
body: The one problem I'd solve is race relations and the lack of opportunity and equality. It matters to me because everyone deserves the chance to succeed.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Losing SC Identity
body: The one problem I'd solve is loosing our South Carolina identity. Losing agriculture is huge and as it's the state's backbone. Losing land to development is ccreating a loss for local residents.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Rural Roads Dangerous
body: I want to fix the roads especially the secondary ones. We live in a semi rural area and the roads are too narrow and pot hole filled. This leads to reoccuring tire and wheel damage and it makes for dangerous driving situations.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Unequal Road Maintenance
body: My top priority is road and bridge paving and repair.  It needs to be spread equally across the state in a more efficient manner. The roads then need to be maintained properly to extend their useful life span--and not concentrated in areas of powerful politicians. Bad roads cause excessive wear and tear on my vehicles. It results in increased maintenance and shorter life span creating added expenses.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Dangerous Drivers Everywhere
body: My biggest concern is people driving like maniacs. They are running lights, speeding, and driving too close. I absolutely hate leaving my house any more than necessary. I've witnessed so many accidents or near accidents, including accidents leading to deaths. I've personally been involved in so many near accidents due to poor drivers.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Cyclist Safety Issues
body: My top priority is infrastructure: oads, bike paths, public transit, clean water, renewable energy. It is not keeping pace with our state's growth. As an avid cyclist and walker, I experience the deficiencies in safe roads several times a week.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Can't Get Point A to B
body: My top priority is crappy infrastructure. It matters to me because can't get from point a to point b without excessive traffic and poorly maintained roads.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Potholes Safety Concern
body: I want us to tackle poorly maintained roads. It matters to me because pot holes and poorly drained roads are a safety concern.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Vehicle Repair Costs
body: I want us to improve our roads. It matters to me because I spend countless dollars on vehicle repair because of how\ bad the roads are.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Widen 95 and 26
body: I want us to widen 95 and 26. It matters to me because travel through the state is so dangerous. At this point, traveling on holidays is impossible and it keeps families apart.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Poor Driving Skills
body: I want us to improve road safety and the lack of driving skills. It matters to me because every drive is a risk because people do not know what is correct.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Culture Wars Distract from Real Issues
body: I want us to address the partisan politics created by our government that is focused on culture war issues instead of real issues facing our state. Our infrastructure is crumbling. Our schools are underfunded. These are important issues that need to be fixed for the future of our state.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Partisanship Attacks Rights
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be partisanship controlling the state government. It matters to me because yes, attacks on individual rights, free speech and public education.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Tax Accountability Lacking
body: My top priority is extreme taxes. There is no accountability or transparency in this state.  South Carolina residents pay multiple forms of taxation, including on food, clothing, vehicles, property, and income. Despite this significant tax burden, the condition of our roads remains poor, and the public education system continues to face serious challenges. Greater transparency, accountability, and strategic investment are needed to ensure taxpayer dollars are producing measurable improvements in infrastructure and education.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Corruption Undermines Trust
body: South Carolina should focus on corruption. It matters to me because corruption at the state level undermines our community and collective trust in systems. If everyone is apathetic to the corruption of the legislature then no one will ever take action to stop it.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Better Elderly and Disabled Care
body: I want us to tackle a lack of compassion, accountability, and accomodations for the elderly and disabled. I am a sole caregiver for two relatives and I struggle with the frustration from this all the time.  I need more help and support to care for my family members.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Political Division Hurts Relationships
body: We should solve cultural disharmony.  There is growing distrust and hate between races, genders, political parties, etc. It has pulled apart family and friends whilst also causing me to be less friendly and open-minded. I'm a right-leaning moderate ("independent") male. People from both sides of the aisle don't like my views.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Poor Leadership Decisions
body: My top priority is unsuitable leadership. It matters to me because it is frustrating to see bad decisions being made. I am very weary of their decision making that results in more hardships for residents.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Gerrymandering and Representation
body: We need to stop gerrymandering, which has led to super majorities in the statehouse. It matters to me because there is a lack of representation in state policy making.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Family Court Corruption
body: If we could address one problem, it would be lack of resources and family court corruption. I cannot afford or get legal help to stop violation of a court order and the harmthat is being done to me.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Need More Diverse Leadership
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be lack of diversified leadership. It matters to me because making decisions and passing laws without including the opposite sex or minority input is wrong and prejudiced.  We need more diversity in our elected office.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Broken Judicial Ethics
body: I want us to tackle the broken judicial system. It matters to me because it affects the ethics for the entire state.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Career Politicians Problem
body: I want us to fix lack of true leadership because career politicians do not have the citizens best interests in mind. I want a government that speaks up for the people and actually helps them with their issues.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Legislature Ignores Voters
body: I want us to tackle the difference between what the polls show South Carolinians care about and what our legislature spends their time on.  It affects everyone in South Carolina who would like to see our leaders be responsive to all their voters, not just the 10% of their base who helped them win their primaries.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Children and Gun Violence
body: South Carolina should focus on reducing violence and gun violence. I'm tired and sad of reading about so many children being shot.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Murder of Family Member
body: My top priority is crime. It matters to me because my family member was murdered.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Poverty Overwhelms Courts
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be poverty. I work in the law. So many poor people are unrepresented it overwhelms the courts.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Harm Reduction Programs Needed
body: South Carolina should focus on Low Country harm reduction programs to help educate the community and those with active substance use disorder. I work with this under represented group of South Carolinians daily and I see the importance of this service.  It is disheartening to see people who want change but are not be supported by the community.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Mass Incarceration Crisis
body: My top priority is mass incarceration. Many of my peers, family and friends are sitting behind bars because of over sentenced by the judicial system.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Farm and Family Survival
body: South Carolina should focus on input prices and commodity markets. It matters to me because it is difficult to save a family and a farm.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Meeting Basic Needs
body: We need to care of all our people. It doesn't affect me personally I have a close family but it hurts to see people not having their basic needs met.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Division and Food Bank Shame
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be extreme division fueled by economic disparities. I've gone to some food banks. My kids have been bullied because of it.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Keeping Young Talent Here
body: The biggest problem the state faces is keeping the younger intellectual generation here. There isn't enough industry--and look at the colleges.  There is major disparity. I want every South Carolinian to be treated with dignity and have equal opportunities.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Need for Education Innovation
body: The one problem I'd solve is innovation in the public school system. Learn a lesson from Mississippi, who found new ways to improve education. I know because I am an educator.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Public School Quality Crisis
body: My top priority is SC is in the lower third of every national ranking of k-12 public education metrics. The partisan politics answer is to give up and give stipends for school "choice". This eventually further erodes public school quality and, ultimately, corrodes the societal and cultural fabric of our communities. I have 4 grandsons in public school and I want the best education possible for them. The real challenge is keeping our state competitive and prosperous while also being a safe and nurturing place for all citizens.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Education Lifts from Poverty
body: I want us to tackle education. Education is essential to lifting South Carolinians out of poverty. Education is essential to a healthy population as well. Yes, when our population doesn't know how to read and write, when our population is ignorant on making healthy lifestyle choices, it affects all of us.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Education Reform
body: We need stronger education reform: restructuring schools to create graduate students who are truly work-ready. Strengthening technical colleges: expanding and enhancing programs to supply skilled workers for industry. It matters to me because we need a better future.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Schools Drive Community Growth
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be education. The education system in our area is crucial for community growth. Our community's development is contingent upon the improvement of our schools. Unless our education system is enhanced, it is unlikely that individuals will stay here, and consequently, industries and companies will not establish themselves in the area.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Support for Teachers Needed
body: South Carolina should focus on lack of support for teachers and public education. I have children and I worry about their future and the low quality of education.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Poor Education Impacts All
body: I want us to tackle weak education. It matters to me because a poorly educated state impacts everyone and their future.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Education Ranking Decline
body: One of the biggest challenges South Carolina faces is the continual decline of our education and the continued low ranking compared to other states in the nation. I am a public school teacher in South Carolina and a product of South Carolina public schools. Beyond my direct involvement, education impacts me and every other South Carolinian in one way or another.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Teacher Development Matters
body: My top priority is pre k-12 teacher development and retention. I have a 7-month old great granddaughter whose mother is an educator, as is her father, as was his father. She deserves the best education.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Teacher Recruitment and Retention
body: We should solve how this state recruits and keeps quality teachers. It matters to me because we need dedicated teachers at the front of the classroom.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Quality Education Investment
body: The one problem I'd solve is quality education at all levels. Education generates tomorrow's citizen. The next generation are the citizens that create the future of our state and America.  They deserve better education.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: School-to-Prison Pipeline
body: I want us to tackle prison reform, especially the school to prison pipeline needs to be dismantled. As a result of it so many are being misdiagnosed, therefore, leaving them with a psychotic drug dependency. As a controlling mechanism they go from home to school to jail. For 20 yrs I have been fighting for change beginning with my son.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Economic Inequality Gap
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be economic parity between the people who have more and the working poor.  It is very unfair and I see my fellow neighbors struggling.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Can't Save for College
body: I am discouraged by the fact that I cannot save enough money for college. The cost of living is too high and I work two jobs.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Can't Afford the Basics
body: I am unable to make enough money to pay for my famliy's basic needs. I went to college and I've worked for 20 years. Why can't I afford the basics?!
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Children's Future Affordability
body: We should solve affordability. It directly affects my children's' ability to make an independent life for themselves and their future families.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Healthcare Worker Undervalued
body: One of the biggest challenges facing South Carolina right now is the combination of low wages, limited worker benefits, and widespread economic insecurity, which interacts with problems in education, housing, and healthcare to make it harder for many residents to get ahead. I am a certified medical assistant by trade. I have worked in the industry for nearly 30 years. I have been unemployed for 11 months now since moving here because I will not take a job paying $15/per hour for my skill set.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Lack of Economic Investment
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be no economic prosperity because there is no major investment. It matters to me because there's a major lack of jobs in the states. No investment = poverty.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: State Minimum Wage Crisis
body: The one problem I'd solve is too low state minimum wage, which is stuck at $7 dollars an hour. It matters to me because it is hard to get a good paying job.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Fixed Income Grocery Costs
body: My top priority is cost of living because it has gotten so high. Groceries usually run me over $100 each week. I am 71 and live on a fixed income.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Manufacturing Wages Too Low
body: South Carolina should focus on decent manufacturing jobs and wages that will support a family. My co-workers and I make $12 an hour. It is barely enough to live on.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Feeding Family Costs
body: South Carolina should focus on cost of living. It matters to me because it affects daily life and my ability to feed my family.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Need for Well-Paying Jobs
body: The one problem I'd solve is jobs. It matters to me because we need well paying ones to survive.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Youth Employment Struggles
body: We need good paying jobs. I'm retired but I see so many young people struggling.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: High-Paying Tech Jobs
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be we need more high paying white collar jobs in information technology. Yes, I would like to remain in SC and not have to relocate to Virginia.
project_title: Welcome to The South Carolina Forum!

title: Low Wages and Union Support
body: I want us to tackle low wages and the lack of unions to protect workers. It matters to me workers don't have leverage over their employers.

title: Rising Cost of Living
body: South Carolina should focus on price inflation of food, services and energy. Cost of living has dramatically increased causing me to cut back.  It is harder to afford my basic needs.

title: Division Blocks Progress
body: We should tackle the divided political structure. It affects most people including me because we can't get anything accomplished.

title: Overcrowding Stress
body: My top priority is infrastructure. Overcrowding. It gets my stress level up with all the cars and nowhere to go. People are running red lights and turning left and cutting people off. Government only cares about the money and doesn't care about us.

title: Economic Opportunity for All
body: If we could solve one problem, it would be economic opportunity for all residents. It matters to me because the lack of opportunity leads to poor outcomes, like higher crime, more reliance on government subsidies, and a lower quality of life for everyone.
